acceptance_interpretation.events_owner: Apply macro-F1 >=0.90 and accepted-label precision >=0.95; separately disclose exact wrong-owner, false-commitment, accepted-false-unknown and abstention counts for the boolean owner/final-status requirement. No new numerical zero-error criterion is invented.
acceptance_interpretation.raw_vs_calibrated: Report both complete raw and frozen-calibrated views. The calibrated macro-F1 counts threshold abstentions as false negatives, including correct raw labels. A good raw score does not authorize bypassing the preregistered calibrated policy after seeing held-out results.
acceptance_interpretation.speaker_names: Apply accepted positive-name precision >=0.98, actual positive-name coverage >=0.50 and zero accepted positive names on gold unknown cases.
acceptance_interpretation.templates: Apply macro-F1 >=0.90, accepted positive-suggestion precision >=0.95 and actual positive-suggestion coverage >=0.50. Decline-class accuracy is reported but cannot satisfy suggestion coverage.
acceptance_interpretation.thresholds: No refitting, normalization or cutoff changes were performed.

costs.definition: Sum unique recorded atomic attempt billed_cost_usd; do not sum duplicated row-level totals. Missing attempt cost remains unknown, not zero; account/key-usage reconciliation is owned by the coordinating agent.

limitations: Twelve independent translated meeting groups per task/language/order; authored and reversed examples are paired, not 24 independent meetings.
Language translations share scenario groups; do not pool languages into a universal quality winner.
Fixed name candidates and short controlled grammar; not open-vocabulary extraction, acoustic identification or natural-meeting acceptance.
The supplement repairs an observed design limit and remains a separate preregistered experiment; do not replace or pool v1 results.

Serial resource/timing measurements are a separate preregistered panel and are not adjudicated here. Quality-call latencies with recovery/concurrency differences are not substituted for serial performance evidence.
Point estimates on twelve groups per order do not establish a broad precision or calibration guarantee.
The original failed calibration Mercury502 and held-out Clef429 remain in sample counts; unsent placeholders are not treated as observed model failures.
